integrity: All polynomial divisions, quotient-ideal cardinalities, corrected factorizations, component weight distributions, and LCD Gram tests are recomputed exactly by a standalone standard-library verifier.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the literal \(t=2\) specialization of the first \(p=13,n=7\) generator row. It does not assess the other rows or refute the abstract existence theorem. A possible presentation interpretation is that the printed coefficients are residue-field representatives requiring an unstated \(t\)-dependent Hensel lift.
title: Table 1's \(p=13,n=7\) generator needs a genuine Hensel lift at \(t=2\)
